original_query: select supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year, sum(volume) as revenue from ( select n1.n_name as supp_nation, n2.n_name as cust_nation, extract(year from l_shipdate) as l_year, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) as volume from supplier, lineitem, orders, customer, nation n1, nation n2 where s_suppkey = l_suppkey and o_orderkey = l_orderkey and c_custkey = o_custkey and s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey and c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey and ( (n1.n_name = 'ETHIOPIA' and n2.n_name = 'FRANCE') or (n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' and n2.n_name = 'ETHIOPIA') ) and l_shipdate between date '1995-01-01' and date '1996-12-31' ) as shipping group by supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year order by supp_nation, cust_nation, l_year;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM lineitem AS l
JOIN supplier AS s
  ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN nation AS n1
  ON s.s_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN customer AS c
  ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN nation AS n2
  ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE n1.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE')
  AND n2.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA', 'FRANCE')
  AND n1.n_name <> n2.n_name
  AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01'
  AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY
    n1.n_name,
    n2.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate)
ORDER BY
    supp_nation,
    cust_nation,
    l_year;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Replace the OR-based nation pair condition with n1.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA','FRANCE'), n2.n_name IN ('ETHIOPIA','FRANCE') AND n1.n_name <> n2.n_name; this is exactly equivalent and keeps the per-side filters pushable while simplifying the residual join predicate.
Remove the derived table `shipping` and aggregate directly; the subquery was already flattened by the optimizer, so eliminating it only improves readability with no semantic change.
Replace BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' with the half-open range >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND < DATE '1997-01-01'; identical for DATE columns and more robust/index-friendly.
Convert old-style comma joins to explicit ANSI INNER JOINs, making join order and conditions explicit; the optimizer already produces hash joins so the plan is unchanged.
No additional constant folding opportunities exist beyond the date literals; EXTRACT(YEAR ...) must remain since it derives the grouping key.
